mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decline is not sustained over 3 months, or 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during easing periods.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE crosses above 5.0% from below, it triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened labor market uncertainty.
failure_condition: If UNRATE crosses above 5.0% but 20-day returns are not negative, or the crossing is not sustained (e.g., reverts within 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in GDPC1 (demand) over 3 months creates a dual bullish signal, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the FEDFUNDS decline and GDPC1 rise are not concurrent over 3 months, or returns are not significantly positive (p < 0.05) when both occur.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock recovery regime, a sustained increase in INDPRO over 3 months predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as production capacity expands.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increase is not sustained over 3 months in the supply shock recovery regime, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month upward trend in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days as immediate consumption growth boosts equity valuations.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 trend is not upward over 3 months, or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the trend.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL (inflation) crosses above 2.0% from below, it triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days due to market concerns over sustained inflation.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL crosses above 2% but returns are not negative (p > 0.05), or the inflation spike is not sustained (reverts within 2 months).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a concurrent rise in PAYEMS (unemployment) and fall in FEDFUNDS over 3 months creates a conflicting but net bullish signal, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS rise and FEDFUNDS fall are not concurrent over 3 months, or returns are not significantly positive (p < 0.05) during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained rise in HOUST (demand in manufacturing) over 3 months predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days as industrial activity strengthens.
failure_condition: If HOUST rise is not sustained over 3 months in late-cycle expansion, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during such periods.
